mandate: C321 — test the cross-sectional INTRADAY RANGE / BREAKOUT / OVERNIGHT-vs-INTRADAY SEASONALITY mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1440 pre-registered configs). Signals (score = -seasonal-mispricing, long seasonally-low / short seasonally-high): range_dev (intraday range intensity |r| vs trailing same-tod mean), brk_dev (position-in-running-day-range vs trailing same-tod mean), oi_dev (prev-day overnight-minus-intraday spread vs trailing-L-day mean), vol_z (vol-scaled range deviation), ewm_dev (range intensity vs causal ewm same-tod baseline). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs charged on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy variants). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and structure-vs-placebo attribution.

methodology.buckets: bar-of-day (tod)=seconds-of-day//300 (0..287, one per day); day index=days since 2023-01-01 (0..1095); exact 288 bars per UTC day on the uniform common grid.
methodology.structure: absr=|log_return| (intraday range intensity); pos_range=(close-running_low)/(running_high-running_low) within each UTC day (running high/low = cummax/cummin of close; 0.5 when the range is degenerate) = position-in-range breakout metric; overnight_ret=log_return at the day's first bar (close-to-close across midnight); intraday_ret=sum of the day's bars 1..287 (open->close); oi_spread=overnight_ret-intraday_ret (per day).
methodology.signals: range_dev=-(absr-mean_L(absr at same tod)); brk_dev=-(pos_range-mean_L(pos_range at same tod)); oi_dev=-(oi_spread_prevday-mean_L(oi_spread up to prevday)) (causal, previous completed day only); vol_z=-(absr-mean_L)/std_L(absr at same tod); ewm_dev=-(absr-ewm_mean_L(absr at same tod, causal)). lookback L in days applied as trailing L seasonal occurrences, min_periods=L (fail-closed). score=-mispricing (long seasonally-low/short seasonally-high); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i (pos>0 long).
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute; a lookback without enough valid observations yields NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs flat (0); Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1440 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config structure nets vs placebo_noise (per-asset randomly permuted perp returns, same reference positions); shares = |net| / sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.funding: USDT-M funding unreachable (fapi 451, not in archives) -> excluded (control only).
